finalists.label: Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis
finalists.why: It has multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions in the periventricular and periaqueductal regions, dorsomedial thalami, medial temporal lobes, caudate nuclei, and brainstem, with diffusion restriction and low ADC values.

finalists.label: Neuromyelitis Optica
finalists.why: It has a 3-day history of acute urinary retention, progressive neurological deficits, marked paraparesis of the lower limbs, and multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions.

finalists.label: Acute Transverse Myelitis
finalists.why: It has marked paraparesis of the lower limbs and hyperreflexia with sustained clonus in the lower extremities.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most decisive findings, including multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions, and accounts for the patient's progressive neurological deficits and paraparesis.
